title: Careless Whisper
lyrics:
[00:26.81]I feel so unsure
[00:32.71]As I take your hand and lead you to the dance floor
[00:39.74]As the music dies, something in your eyes
[00:45.53]Calls to mind a silver screen and all its sad goodbyes
[00:52.34]I'm never gonna dance again
[00:54.92]Guilty feet have got no rhythm
[00:58.42]Though it's easy to pretend
[01:00.98]I know you're not a fool
[01:04.11]I should've known better than to cheat a friend
[01:07.29]And waste the chance that I've been given
[01:10.97]So I'm never gonna dance again
[01:13.59]The way I danced with you
[01:29.57]Time can never mend
[01:35.63]The careless whispers of a good friend
[01:42.51]To the heart and mind, ignorance is kind
[01:48.34]There's no comfort in the truth, pain is all you'll find
[01:55.19]I'm never gonna dance again
[01:57.73]Guilty feet have got no rhythm
[02:01.27]Though it's easy to pretend
[02:03.82]I know you're not a fool
[02:07.03]I should've known better than to cheat a friend (Should've known better)
[02:10.10]And waste the chance that I've been given
[02:13.84]So I'm never gonna dance again
[02:16.40]The way I danced with you, oh
[02:25.28]Never without your love
[02:44.86]Tonight the music seems so loud
[02:48.06]I wish that we could lose this crowd
[02:51.44]Maybe it's better this way
[02:54.40]We'd hurt each other with the things we want to say
[02:57.58]We could have been so good together
[03:00.70]We could have lived this dance forever
[03:03.89]But now who's gonna dance with me?
[03:08.79]Please stay
[03:10.84]And I'm never gonna dance again
[03:13.60]Guilty feet have got no rhythm
[03:17.18]Though it's easy to pretend
[03:19.73]I know you're not a fool
[03:22.97]I should've known better than to cheat a friend
[03:26.03]And waste the chance that I've been given
[03:29.63]So I'm never gonna dance again
[03:32.34]The way I danced with you
[03:49.12]Now that you're gone
[03:52.22]Now that you're gone
[04:01.76]Now that you're gone
[04:03.73]Was what I did so wrong, so wrong
[04:09.24]That you had to leave me alone?
